summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Sistema TRAIN sports training planner SaaS. Backend APIs working perfectly (100% pass rate), but frontend has critical authentication persistence issues preventing normal user workflow.

critical_bugs.issue: Authentication session not persisting across page navigation - users get logged out when navigating directly to protected routes
critical_bugs.impact: Users cannot use the application normally - all protected pages redirect to auth page

critical_bugs.issue: Direct navigation to /athletes, /plans, /calendar etc. fails and redirects to auth page even with valid session

integration_issues.flow: Login to Dashboard to Protected Pages
integration_issues.issue: While login works initially, subsequent navigation breaks authentication state

passed_tests: Landing page loads with hero, features, pricing sections
Initial login and dashboard redirect works
Dashboard displays stats and content when accessible
Athletes page displays correctly when accessible
action_item_for_main_agent: Fix critical authentication persistence issue in frontend. The auth context/token storage is not working correctly - users can login but session doesn't persist for protected route navigation. Need to check AuthContext token storage, localStorage persistence, and protected route implementation.
